plugins.name: debrief
plugins.description: Local TTS-only companion for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok on Apple Silicon Macs via MCP speak.
plugins.installation: Build and run `debrief install --claude` (or a full install). Restart Claude Code so mcp__debrief__speak appears. Use skill debrief-speak at turn end.
plugins.privacy: Speaks only agent-provided text through the local headless daemon. No STT, no cloud summarization, no transcript upload.
